findings.body: The Done-when requirement remains unmet in two runtime paths. Inline runs call compileSpawnSystemPrompt without gantryToolSelection (apps/core/src/runtime/agent-spawn-host.ts:192–213), so this conditional omits the inventory and delegation gate entirely for both inline engines. Worker runs advertise only MCP names, although the DeepAgents runner also mounts Gantry facade and shell tools (apps/core/src/adapters/llm/deepagents-langchain/runner/mcp-tools.ts:210–247), including WebSearch and WebRead. Those capabilities are absent from the supposedly authoritative availability list. Derive instructions from the complete mounting selection for worker and inline runs.

findings.body: The new boundary proof compares the prompt with effectiveEnabledMcpToolNames and DeepAgents selectedToolNames, rather than tools registered and exposed by the runner. It never exercises inline prompt preparation or connectGantryAndThirdPartyMcpTools. Consequently, all six scenarios pass despite the missing inline inventory and omitted worker facade tools. The SDK integration tests likewise inspect configuration passed to the fake SDK without compiling run availability. Add an owner-boundary test comparing the final instructions with the actual exposed Gantry tools, covering these omitted runtime paths and their delegation gates.
